notes.title: Day 2 Patch: Leaderboard support and various fixes.
notes.content:
[h1]Leaderboards![/h1]

Now, after beating a level, you can compare your completion time with the rest of the world! Pressing Y on the controller or C on the keyboard on a level's door will bring up a leaderboard tailored to your current difficulty.

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Replaced Xbox controller plugin. Should work for everyone now.
[*]Achievements now pop up immediately, not on closing the game.
[*]Many insignificant things.
[/list]
